notes.title: The Red Exile — Release is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41207362/4d608f9f0fb35fa0465e36003f9e139a88be69e5.png[/img]

[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

We have been walking towards this day for several months, and today it has arrived. The Red Exile is ready to leave early access and move into the status of a released game. Hooray!

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added hands and animations for all items.
[*] NipoCola was removed and a syringe added in its place.
[*] Changed the lighting in the rooms.
[*] Some perks have been seriously reworked.
[*] New room with an altar.
[*] We have replaced searching chests for the appearance of items on the shelves.
[*] And many, many more inconspicuous details that increase the pleasure of the game.
[/list]
[h3]Future plans:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Localization.
[*] Fixes.
[*] Linux and MacOS builds.
[*] And one secret news.
[/list]
Cheers,
NipoBox Team
